name: Disable LLMNR
description: Disables Link-Local Multicast Name Resolution to reduce unnecessary background name queries on local networks.

description_i18n.en: Disables Link-Local Multicast Name Resolution to reduce unnecessary background name queries on local networks.
description_i18n.de: Deaktiviert die lokale Mehrpunkt-Namensauflösung, um unnötige Hintergrundabfragen im Netzwerk zu reduzieren.
description_i18n.fr: Désactive la résolution de noms multicast locale pour réduire les requêtes inutiles en arrière-plan sur le réseau local.

warnings.title: Registry change
warnings.message: Persistent Windows settings may change until the tweak is restored

compatibility.notes: Designed for supported Windows desktop systems.

technical_details: Modifies the registry value EnableMulticast at HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows NT\DNSClient to set it to 0
